query:
UPDATE schools 
                        SET name = COALESCE($1, name),
                            npsn = COALESCE($2, npsn),
                            address = $3,
                            phone_number = COALESCE($4, phone_number),
                            email = COALESCE($5, email),
                            updated_at = NOW()
                        WHERE tenant_id = $6
